item.title: Rishabh Pant can make Virender Sehwag-like impact: Angelo Mathews
item.summary: Angelo Mathews has been a part of a Sri Lankan team which had heady battles with India, especially on their own turf. He believes a player like Rishabh Pant should be backed by the management as he too could have an impact like Virender Sehwag did in Sri Lanka.
